none: PAS NLM-C5BF98: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria Exercitus issue, probably of 330-335. Reece period 17. Probably a copy. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]VN NOB C[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with probably two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 11.7mm, Weight: 0.86gms, die axis: 6
